title: Add order listing endpoint with status filter and sorting
description:
Adds `GET /orders` so the account page can list a customer's orders.

- optional `status` filter (`pending`, `paid`, `shipped`, `cancelled`)
- `sort` limited to an allow-list of columns, newest first
- page size defaults to 20, capped at 100

Tests cover the default listing, the filter, the sort fallback and the page-size cap.
